{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the actual sites present
sites = df['site'].unique()
print(f"Actual sites in data: {sorted(sites)}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].index
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Patients with multiple rows: {list(duplicates)[:5]}...")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")"}
